APP.TITLE: Picsur
APP.DESCRIPTION: Easy open source image sharing platform

HOST_OVERRIDE.NAME: Host Override
HOST_OVERRIDE.HELP: Override the hostname for the server, useful for when you are accessing the server from a different domain.

REMOVE_DERIVATIVES_AFTER.NAME: Cached Images Expiry Time
REMOVE_DERIVATIVES_AFTER.HELP: Time before cached converted images are deleted. This does not affect the original image. A lower cache time will save on disk space but cost more cpu. Set to 0 to disable.

ALLOW_EDITING.NAME: Allow images to be edited
ALLOW_EDITING.HELP: Allow images to be edited (e.g. resize, flip). Using these features will use more CPU power.

CONVERSION_TIME_LIMIT.NAME: Convert/Edit Time Limit
CONVERSION_TIME_LIMIT.HELP: Time limit for converting/editing images. You may need to increase this on low powered devices.

CONVERSION_MEMORY_LIMIT.NAME: Convert/Edit Memory Limit MB
CONVERSION_MEMORY_LIMIT.HELP: Memory limit for converting/editing images. You only need to increase this if you are storing massive images.

JWT_SECRET.NAME: JWT Secret
JWT_SECRET.HELP: Secret used to sign JWT authentication tokens.

JWT_EXPIRES_IN.NAME: JWT Expiry Time
JWT_EXPIRES_IN.HELP: Time before JWT authentication tokens expire.

BCRYPT_STRENGTH.NAME: BCrypt Strength
BCRYPT_STRENGTH.HELP: Strength of BCrypt hashing algorithm, 10 is recommended. Reduce this if running on a low powered device.

ENABLE_TRACKING.NAME: Enable Ackee Web Tracking
ENABLE_TRACKING.HELP: Enable tracking of the website usage using Ackee. You will need to set the tracking URL and ID.

TRACKING_URL.NAME: Ackee tracking URL
TRACKING_URL.HELP: URL of the Ackee tracking server. Requests are proxied, so ensure the X-Forwarded-For header is handled.

TRACKING_ID.NAME: Ackee tracking website ID
TRACKING_ID.HELP: ID of the website to track.

ENABLE_TELEMETRY.NAME: Enable System Telemetry
ENABLE_TELEMETRY.HELP: Enable system telemetry, this will send anonymous usage data to the developers.

KEEP_ORIGINAL.NAME: Keep original file
KEEP_ORIGINAL.HELP: Store the original files you upload to the service, this way no data will be lost. This will also store exif data.
